overall_reason: A 'Weekly activity' stat card ('124 tasks completed', five gradient bars) on a lavender-to-pink gradient: a number drawn as marks, with no subject of its own.

score.reason: T-SIGNATURE fails (a number drawn as bars is the stand-in CON-005 names), T-COVER-TEXT fails (hide the text and only a pastel gradient remains), and T-DEFAULT-AGENT holds for the whole card.

findings.title: One real signature on the first screen
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png '124 tasks completed / 18 more than last week' sits over five unscaled bars labelled M to F with no values.
findings.after: Show which tasks or which day mattered, for example the day with the most completions and what was finished. [DATA NEEDED: task breakdown]
findings.why: The card repeats a count without telling the reader anything they can act on.

findings.title: No look picked for the category or by default
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the card ground runs pink to lavender to pale blue, the bars use a violet-to-pink gradient, and the title, number and link are all violet.
findings.before: Pastel violet gradient on every surface.
findings.after: Use a neutral ground, one data colour for the bars and neutral ink for text.
findings.why: The gradient look belongs to a look family, not to this product, and it lowers text contrast.

strengths: The comparison line '18 more than last week' gives the number a reference point.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
